Landlord correspondence is also listed as missing but optional.
result.answer: First establish whether Olivia received a written termination notice and, if so, when and what end date it states; the process is waiting for that answer before proceeding to deadline preservation.
open_points: Has Olivia received a written termination notice? If so, when was it received and what termination date does it state?

The checklist lists as missing, depending on the answer to receipt: lease contract; termination notice; proof of receipt; notice-period evidence; stated termination reason; cure notice with termination warning; and rent ledger/payment evidence. Landlord correspondence is listed as missing but optional.
Could also help: any envelope, registered-mail collection slip, or other delivery record, given the reported shared-mailbox delivery concern.

clauses.text: We understand that you are seeking advice about a possible termination of your tenancy.

Please confirm whether you have received a written termination notice. If you have, please tell us when it arrived and what termination date it states, and send us a copy of the notice and any envelope, delivery record or registered-mail collection slip. These details will allow us to assess the deadline and the next steps.
